description: A current reflection can reconnect to an authorised reader memory without any book context.

input.cue: I rushed to fill the silence again today, even though I wanted the group to think together.

tool_evidence.excerpt: When I feel rushed, I use certainty to replace process. I want to return to that before the next high-stakes review, not because it is a permanent truth about me, but because it is a pattern I can actually test.

criteria: Connects the current urge to fill silence with the earlier certainty-as-process reflection
Preserves the difference between one current incident and a previously observed pattern
Does not diagnose the reader or turn the memory into a fixed trait
forbidden_claims: The pattern proves a personality disorder
